title: fix(plugin-form): DrawerForm holds the loading state until the first record read lands (#10190)
body:
Fixes #10190

## What

`DrawerForm` no longer paints an editable form while the FIRST record read is in flight. The field-building effect now ends the loading state only when no record read is outstanding, judged by the same `loadedRecordIdRef` the record-swap path already uses (no new flag). A load the fetch effect started is ended by the fetch effect.

## Mechanism, reproduced (the card's reading was a reading; it is now a measurement)

Both effects key on `objectSchema`, so the commit that publishes the schema runs both, fetch first: the fetch effect enters loading and fires `findOne`, and the fields effect, declared second, used to call `setLoading(false)` unconditionally. Measured with a real `DrawerForm` and a `findOne` held open by the test (deferred promise), then typing `typed` while it is pending, then resolving it with a record whose `title` is `Record One`:

| container / shape | editable input while read pending | on screen after typing | on screen after the record lands |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| DrawerForm / flat `fields`, base `0aacecc08` | yes | `typed` | `Record One` (typed value lost) |
| DrawerForm / `sections`, base `0aacecc08` | yes | `typed` | `Record One` (typed value lost) |
| DrawerForm / flat `fields`, this branch | no input rendered | n/a | `Record One` |
| DrawerForm / `sections`, this branch | no input rendered | n/a | `Record One` |

This discriminates between the two readings the card named. A stale `handleSubmit` closure would leave the DOM showing `typed` and lose it only on submit; instead the DOM itself flips from `typed` to `Record One` when the record lands, which is the landing record replacing the form's values. The committed CONTROL row closes the other side: a value typed AFTER the record has landed is exactly what reaches `update` (`title: 'typed'`), so the submit closure is not stale.

## Tests

- New pin `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/drawerFirstLoadWindow-10190.test.tsx` (flat and sectioned shapes): no editable input while the first read is held open; a value typed after landing is the value submitted (CONTROL); create mode reads no record and renders editable straight away.
- Ablation, run from committed HEAD `982dd06` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `if (!recordReadOutstanding) setLoading(false);` swapped for `void recordReadOutstanding; setLoading(false);`, anchor x1 to x0, blob `7de35968397a` to `307856385b75`): the two window rows went red (`Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`), the CONTROL and create rows stayed green; restore verified as blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt used a replacement that is a substring of the anchor, which the tool refused as a no-op (count 6 to 6) and restored; it measured nothing.
- `fieldSecurityPayload.test.tsx`: the `editAllowedFieldAndSubmit` helper now waits for `RECORD.actual_value` to be ON SCREEN before typing, not merely for the input to exist. After this fix the drawer row no longer needs it, but the ModalForm row does (see below: ModalForm still holds the same window). No FLS assertion was touched, skipped or loosened.

Local results, all at HEAD `f390b0c` (tree clean, merged with `origin/main`, which had not moved from the base):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/src/fieldSecurityPayload.test.tsx` x5, from the repo root: 5 of 5 exit 0, `Tests 12 passed (12)` each.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/`: `Test Files 113 passed (113)`, `Tests 1100 passed | 1 skipped (1101)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` exit 0, after building the dependency closure (`--filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build`); `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes both changed test files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form lint` exit 0 (0 errors). `DrawerForm.tsx` carries the same 22 warnings, by rule, as at the base.
- `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: all exit 0.
- Not run locally: repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test` farm. Those are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **ModalForm holds the same window.** Measured with the same harness: an editable input is present while the read is pending, and `typed` becomes `Record One` when the record lands, in both flat and sectioned shapes. Its fields effect ends loading unconditionally, the same way. Not edited here: objectui#9849 step two owns `ModalForm` next.
- **ObjectForm does not hold it.** No input is rendered while the read is pending, in either shape.
- The card suggested two named flags (`schemaReady` / `recordReady`). This takes the narrower route of reusing the existing record ref, so there is one source of truth for "which record the form holds" instead of a second boolean that can disagree with it.
- The gate also covers a case the card did not name: a fields-effect re-run in the middle of a record SWAP (for example a caller that rebuilds `fields` on each render) could previously end the swap's loading state early. It now leaves that to the fetch effect too. This half is a reading of the code, not a measurement: no test here rebuilds `fields` across a swap.
- Changeset: `.changeset/10190-drawerform-first-load-window.md`, patch for `@object-ui/plugin-form`.
